semantic_usage.lineup: Arrange red/yellow football teams on a tactics board
semantic_usage.squad: Player roster, never people submitting ratings
semantic_usage.ranking: Rankings, never goal counts or position badges
semantic_usage.match-history: Match calendar, never backups or change logs
semantic_usage.player-form: Neutral assessment from recent match outcomes, not guaranteed improvement
semantic_usage.goal: Standalone 3D football beside goal totals, not a goal-net illustration
semantic_usage.football: Standalone ball for football labels, scorers and small goal counters
semantic_usage.trophy: Reuse the golden ranking cup for achievement/winning labels
semantic_usage.medals: Gold, silver and bronze identify distinct ranks
semantic_usage.match-score: Editing a football match score; not recording individual goals
semantic_usage.goal-record: Scorers, individual goal entry and goal review
semantic_usage.player-rating: Assessing a player's skills, ratings and AI Form
semantic_usage.match-analysis: Neutral comparison and analysis of both football teams
semantic_usage.finance-ledger: Club ledger, balance and recording income or expenses
semantic_usage.activity-log: Edit history and administrative action logs, not match schedules

small_controls.style: Filled multicolour miniature illustrations with solid bodies and contrasting details
small_controls.note: Code-native controls remain crisp at 14–24px; the cup and standalone football use bitmap artwork.

web_export.note: Web exports retain the same generated artwork; original PNGs remain alongside them.

Centered single object group occupying 82% of a square canvas, front three-quarter view, restrained material detail, soft studio highlights, gentle tight contact shadow. Actual transparent background with alpha, no floor or background rectangle, no app tile, no checkerboard, no lettering, no watermark, no outline drawing.

prompt_prefix_v3: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium sports-app UI icon as a transparent-background bitmap. Primary request: a single centered colorful rounded 3D clay/enamel illustration, robust readable silhouette at 24–40px. Consistent family: softly beveled solid objects, slightly isometric front view, violet and midnight-blue structure, bright restrained gold/red/green accents, white highlights, soft ambient shading. The subject must convey the specific function below, not a decorative generic football trophy. Square canvas, generous transparent padding, subject fills about 78% of canvas. No background, no white rectangle, no text, no letters, no digits, no logos, no watermark, no thin outline-only artwork.

assets.prompt_subject: Subject: Two chunky football jerseys side by side, one rich tomato red with white collar, one golden yellow with navy sleeves, and a small white/navy football between them. This icon means creating two football teams.

Subject: A friendly football-player bust wearing a blue-violet jersey in front, two smaller red and yellow jersey silhouettes behind, a compact squad symbol. Warm simple face, no identifiable real person. This icon means the football squad/player list.
Subject: A gleaming golden football trophy cup with broad rounded handles, a tiny football motif at its bowl, short violet base. Icon for rankings and achievements.

Subject: A thick sky-blue and lavender desktop calendar page with coral binding rings and a small colorful football badge in its lower corner. Calendar has simple embossed colored squares, absolutely no text or numerals. This icon means match history.

Subject: A chunky violet-and-blue sports performance chart with three rounded rising bars, a curved mint upward arrow in front, and a small golden star. This icon means football player form and fitness evaluation.
Subject: A chunky lavender-purple leather wallet with blue flap and round golden snap, two shiny gold coins peeking out. This icon means the football club's shared income/expenses.

Subject: A chunky green football tactics board with a navy-violet rim. Clear white center circle, halfway line, and two goals. Three red round player magnets on one half and three yellow round player magnets on the other half. A small white/navy football at the lower corner. The meaning must clearly be creating and arranging two balanced football teams, not clothing shopping.

Subject: A chunky violet football player profile card with a small blue-violet jersey symbol in its top section. In the lower section, a neutral horizontal recent-match strip of five rounded dots colored green, red, blue, green, red, with equal emphasis. This is evaluating a football player's current form from recent wins, losses, goals and attendance, not financial growth. No rising bars, no upward arrow, no trophy, no star.

Subject: A chunky sky-blue and lavender archive folder containing a small green football-lineup sheet with red and yellow player dots. A clear curved golden restore arrow wraps around the front of the folder. This means saving and restoring football lineup backups, not a match calendar. No calendar rings, no clocks, no trophy.

Subject: A chunky compact football scoreboard with two blank contrasting panels, red team on the left and yellow team on the right, one small white/navy football in front. Convey editing the score of a match. No numbers and no winner trophy.

Subject: One white and midnight-blue football arriving into a compact white football goal net, a gentle curved orange motion accent. Convey goals scored and entering goals. Make the goal opening and net unmistakable. No trophy, no medals, no star.

Subject: A violet clipboard featuring a tiny red football jersey silhouette and three short colored horizontal assessment sliders, with a rounded gold pencil at the side. Convey rating a football player's skills, not match scores. No stars and no text.

Subject: A small green football tactics pitch with a red player marker and yellow player marker on opposite halves; one rounded violet magnifying glass in front. Convey neutral analysis and comparison of a football match. No winner trophy, no scoreboard, no graph implying growth.

Subject: A violet open ledger with a few gold coins, a green arrow pointing into the ledger and a red arrow pointing out. Convey recording income and expenses. No football, no currency characters, no numbers, no trophy.

Subject: A rounded midnight-blue and violet clipboard with three short colored horizontal entry bars and a small round blue clock overlay. Convey a history of edits or administrative actions. No football, no calendar grid, no archive box.
